sections.label: Book 11
sections.name: Building the fire altar: the fire-pan of clay

verses.sa: युञ्जानः प्रथमं मनस्तत्त्वाय सविता धियः। अग्नेर्ज्योतिर्निचाय्य पृथिव्या अध्याऽभरत्॥
verses.tr: yuñjānaḥ prathamaṃ manastattvāya savitā dhiyaḥ agnerjyotirnicāyya pṛthivyā adhyā'bharat
verses.en: Harnessing, first of all, the mind, Savitar having stretched the thought With reverent look upon the light of Agni bore them up from earth.

verses.sa: युक्तेन मनसा वयं देवस्य सवितुः सवे। स्वर्ग्याय शक्त्या॥
verses.tr: yuktena manasā vayaṃ devasya savituḥ save svargyāya śaktyā
verses.en: By impulse of God Savitar we with our spirit harnessed strive With might to win the heavenly.

verses.sa: युक्त्वाय सविता देवान्त्स्वर्यतो धिया दिवम्। बृहज्ज्योतिः करिष्यतः सविता प्र सुवाति तान्॥
verses.tr: yuktvāya savitā devāntsvaryato dhiyā divam bṛhajjyotiḥ kariṣyataḥ savitā pra suvāti tān
verses.en: Savitar, having harnessed Gods who go to light and heavenly thought, Who will create the lofty light—Savitar urge them on their way!

verses.sa: युञ्जते मन उत युञ्जते धियो विप्रा विप्रस्य बृहतो विपश्चितः। वि होत्रा दधे वयुनाविदेक इन्मही देवस्य सवितुः परिष्टुतिः॥
verses.tr: yuñjate mana uta yuñjate dhiyo viprā viprasya bṛhato vipaścitaḥ vi hotrā dadhe vayunāvideka inmahī devasya savituḥ pariṣṭutiḥ
verses.en: The priests of him the lofty priest well skilled in hymns, harness their spirit, yea, harness their holy thoughts. He only, skilled in rules, assigns their priestly tasks. Yea, lofty is the praise of Savitar the God.

verses.sa: युजे वां ब्रह्म पूर्व्यं नमोभिर्वि श्लोक एतु पथ्येव सूरेः। शृण्वन्तु विश्वे अमृतस्य पुत्रा आ ये धामानि दिव्यानि तस्थुः॥
verses.tr: yuje vāṃ brahma pūrvyaṃ namobhirvi śloka etu pathyeva sūreḥ śṛṇvantu viśve amṛtasya putrā ā ye dhāmāni divyāni tasthuḥ
verses.en: I yoke with prayer your ancient inspiration: may the laud rise as on the prince's pathway. All Sons of the Immortal One shall hear it, who have resorted to celestial dwellings.

verses.sa: यस्य प्रयाणमन्वन्य इद्ययुर्देवा देवस्य महिमानमोजसा। यः पार्थिवानि विममे स एतशो रजांसि देवः सविता महित्वना॥
verses.tr: yasya prayāṇamanvanya idyayurdevā devasya mahimānamojasā yaḥ pārthivāni vimame sa etaśo rajāṃsi devaḥ savitā mahitvanā
verses.en: Even he, the God! whose going forth and majesty the other Deities have followed with their might, He who hath measured the celestial regions out by his great power, he is the Courser Savitar.

verses.sa: देव सवितः प्र सुव यज्ञं प्र सुव यज्ञपतिं भगाय। दिव्यो गन्धर्वः केतपूः केतं नः पुनातु वाचस्पतिर्वाचं नः स्वदतु॥
verses.tr: deva savitaḥ pra suva yajñaṃ pra suva yajñapatiṃ bhagāya divyo gandharvaḥ ketapūḥ ketaṃ naḥ punātu vācaspatirvācaṃ naḥ svadatu
verses.en: Our sacrifice, God Savitar! speed forward: speed to his share the sacrifice's patron. May the celestial Gandharva, cleanser of thought and will, make clean our thoughts and wishes. The Lord of Speech sweeten the words we utter!

verses.sa: इमं नो देव सवितर्यज्ञं प्र णय देवाव्यं सखिविदं सत्राजितं धनजितं स्वर्जितम्। ऋचा स्तोमं समर्धय गायत्रेण रथन्तरं बृहद्गायत्रवर्तनि स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: imaṃ no deva savitaryajñaṃ pra ṇaya devāvyaṃ sakhividaṃ satrājitaṃ dhanajitaṃ svarjitam ṛcā stomaṃ samardhaya gāyatreṇa rathantaraṃ bṛhadgāyatravartani svāhā
verses.en: God Savitar, speed this God-loved sacrifice of ours, friend-finding, ever-conquering, winning wealth and heaven. Speed praise>song with the sacred verse, Rathantara with Gayatra, Brihat that runs in Gayatra. All-hail!

verses.sa: देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवेऽश्विनोर्बाहुभ्यां पूष्णो हस्ताभ्याम्। आ ददे गायत्रेण छन्दसाऽङ्गिरस्वत्पृथिव्याः सधस्थादग्निं पुरीष्यमङ्गिरस्वदा भर त्रैष्टुभेन छन्दसाऽङ्गिरस्वत्॥
verses.tr: devasya tvā savituḥ prasave'śvinorbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyām ā dade gāyatreṇa chandasā'ṅgirasvatpṛthivyāḥ sadhasthādagniṃ purīṣyamaṅgirasvadā bhara traiṣṭubhena chandasā'ṅgirasvat
verses.en: By impulse of God Savitar I take thee, with arms of Asvins, with the hands of Pushan, in Angiras manner, with Gayatri metre. From the earth's seat bring thou Purishya Agni, as Angiras was wont, with Trishtup metre.

verses.sa: अभ्रिरसि नार्यसि त्वया वयमग्निं शकेम खनितुं सधस्थ आ। जागतेन छन्दसाऽङ्गिरस्वत्॥
verses.tr: abhrirasi nāryasi tvayā vayamagniṃ śakema khanituṃ sadhastha ā jāgatena chandasā'ṅgirasvat
verses.en: Spade art thou; woman art thou. Ours be power with the© to dig out Agni in his dwelling, as Angiras was wont, with Jagati metre.

verses.sa: हस्त आधाय सविता बिभ्रदभ्रिं हिरण्ययीम्। अग्नेर्ज्योतिर्निचाय्य पृथिव्या अध्याऽभरदानुष्टुभेन छन्दसाऽङ्गिरस्वत्॥
verses.tr: hasta ādhāya savitā bibhradabhriṃ hiraṇyayīm agnerjyotirnicāyya pṛthivyā adhyā'bharadānuṣṭubhena chandasā'ṅgirasvat
verses.en: Savitar, bearing in his hand the gold spade which he took therewith. Looking with reverence on the light of Agni, raised it from the earth. With the Anushtup metre and as Angiras was wont to do.

verses.sa: प्रतूर्तं वाजिन्ना द्रव वरिष्ठामनु संवतम्। दिवि ते जन्म परममन्तरिक्षे तव नाभिः पृथिव्यामधि योनिरित्॥
verses.tr: pratūrtaṃ vājinnā drava variṣṭhāmanu saṃvatam divi te janma paramamantarikṣe tava nābhiḥ pṛthivyāmadhi yonirit
verses.en: Run hither, urged to speed, O Horse, along the most extended ed space. Thy loftiest birthplace is in heaven, thy navel is in air's mid-realm, the womb that bare thee is on earth.

verses.sa: युञ्जाथां रासभं युवमस्मिन् यामे वृषण्वसू। अग्निं भरन्तमस्मयुम्॥
verses.tr: yuñjāthāṃ rāsabhaṃ yuvamasmin yāme vṛṣaṇvasū agniṃ bharantamasmayum
verses.en: Upon this course, O lords of wealth, harness, ye twain, the Ass w ho bears Agni, and kindly favours us.

verses.sa: योगे-योगे तवस्तरं वाजे-वाजे हवामहे। सखाय इन्द्रमूतये॥
verses.tr: yoge-yoge tavastaraṃ vāje-vāje havāmahe sakhāya indramūtaye
verses.en: In every need, in every race we call, as friends, to succour us, na, Indra, the mightiest of all.

verses.sa: प्रतूर्वन्नेह्यवक्रामन्नशस्ती रुद्रस्य गाणपत्यं मयोभूरेहि। उर्वन्तरिक्षं वीहि स्वस्तिगव्यूतिरभयानि कृण्वन् पूष्णा सयुजा सह॥
verses.tr: pratūrvannehyavakrāmannaśastī rudrasya gāṇapatyaṃ mayobhūrehi urvantarikṣaṃ vīhi svastigavyūtirabhayāni kṛṇvan pūṣṇā sayujā saha
verses.en: Come, speeding on and trampling imprecations, come gladdening to the chieftainship of Rudra. Speed through the wide air thou whose paths are pleasant, with Pushan for thy mate, providing safety.

verses.sa: पृथिव्याः सधस्थादग्निं पुरीष्यमङ्गिरस्वदा भराग्निं पुरीष्यमङ्गिरस्वदच्छेमो ऽग्निं पुरीष्यमङ्गिरस्वद्भरिष्यामः॥
verses.tr: pṛthivyāḥ sadhasthādagniṃ purīṣyamaṅgirasvadā bharāgniṃ purīṣyamaṅgirasvadacchemo 'gniṃ purīṣyamaṅgirasvadbhariṣyāmaḥ
verses.en: From the Earth's seat, like Angiras, bring thou Purishya Agni forth. After the wont of Angiras we to Purishya} Agni go. Agni Purishya we will bear after the wont of Angiras.

verses.sa: अन्वग्निरुषसामग्रमख्यदन्वहानि प्रथमो जातवेदाः। अनु सूर्यस्य पुरुत्रा च रश्मीननु द्यावापृथिवी आ ततन्थ॥
verses.tr: anvagniruṣasāmagramakhyadanvahāni prathamo jātavedāḥ anu sūryasya purutrā ca raśmīnanu dyāvāpṛthivī ā tatantha
verses.en: Agni hath looked along the van of Mornings, looked on the days, the earliest Jatavedas, And many a time along the beams of Surya: along the heaven and earth hast thou extended.

verses.sa: आगत्य वाज्यध्वानं सर्वा मृधो वि धूनुते। अग्निं सधस्थे महति चक्षुषा नि चिकीषते॥
verses.tr: āgatya vājyadhvānaṃ sarvā mṛdho vi dhūnute agniṃ sadhasthe mahati cakṣuṣā ni cikīṣate
verses.en: The Courser, started on his way, shakes from him all hostilities. He longs to look with reverent eye on Agni in the mighty seat.

verses.sa: आक्रम्य वाजिन् पृथिवीमग्निमिच्छ रुचा त्वम्। भूम्या वृत्वाय नो ब्रूहि यतः खनेम तं वयम्॥
verses.tr: ākramya vājin pṛthivīmagnimiccha rucā tvam bhūmyā vṛtvāya no brūhi yataḥ khanema taṃ vayam
verses.en: O Courser, having come to earth, seek Agni with a longing wish. Tell us by trampling on the ground where we may dig him from the earth.

verses.sa: द्यौस्ते पृष्ठं पृथिवी सधस्थमात्माऽन्तरिक्षं समुद्रो योनिः। विख्याय चक्षुषा त्वमभि तिष्ठ पृतन्यतः॥
verses.tr: dyauste pṛṣṭhaṃ pṛthivī sadhasthamātmā'ntarikṣaṃ samudro yoniḥ vikhyāya cakṣuṣā tvamabhi tiṣṭha pṛtanyataḥ
verses.en: Heaven is thy back, the earth thy seat, the air thy soul, the sea thy womb. Looking around thee with thine eye trample the adversaries down.

verses.sa: उत्क्राम महते सौभगायास्मादास्थानाद् द्रविणोदा वाजिन्। वयं स्याम सुमतौ पृथिव्या अग्निं खनन्त उपस्थे अस्याः॥
verses.tr: utkrāma mahate saubhagāyāsmādāsthānād draviṇodā vājin vayaṃ syāma sumatau pṛthivyā agniṃ khananta upasthe asyāḥ
verses.en: Wealth-giver, Courser, from this place step forth to great felicity. May we enjoy Earth's favour while we dig forth Agni from her lap.

verses.sa: उदक्रमीद् द्रविणोदा वाज्यर्वाकः सुलोकं सुकृतं पृथिव्याम्। ततः खनेम सुप्रतीकमग्निं स्वो रुहाणा अधि नाकमुत्तमम्॥
verses.tr: udakramīd draviṇodā vājyarvākaḥ sulokaṃ sukṛtaṃ pṛthivyām tataḥ khanema supratīkamagniṃ svo ruhāṇā adhi nākamuttamam
verses.en: Down hath he stepped, wealth-giver, racer, courser. Good and auspicious room on earth thou madest. Thence let us dig forth Agni, fair to look on, while to the loftiest vault we mount, to heaven.

verses.sa: आ त्वा जिघर्मि मनसा घृतेन प्रतिक्षियन्तं भुवनानि विश्वा। पृथुं तिरश्चा वयसा बृहन्तं व्यचिष्ठमन्नै रभसं दृशानम्॥
verses.tr: ā tvā jigharmi manasā ghṛtena pratikṣiyantaṃ bhuvanāni viśvā pṛthuṃ tiraścā vayasā bṛhantaṃ vyaciṣṭhamannai rabhasaṃ dṛśānam
verses.en: I thoughtfully besprinkle thee with butter, thee dwelling near to all existing creatures, Broad, vast through vital power that moves transversely, conspicuous, strong with all the food that feeds thee.

verses.sa: आ विश्वतः प्रत्यञ्चं जिघर्म्यरक्षसा मनसा तज्जुषेत। मर्यश्री स्पृहयद्वर्णो अग्निर्नाभिमृशे तन्वा जर्भुराणः॥
verses.tr: ā viśvataḥ pratyañcaṃ jigharmyarakṣasā manasā tajjuṣeta maryaśrī spṛhayadvarṇo agnirnābhimṛśe tanvā jarbhurāṇaḥ
verses.en: I sprinkle him who moves in all directions: may he accept it with a friendly spirit. Agni with bridegroom's face and lovely colour may not be touched when all his form is fury.

verses.sa: परि वाजपतिः कविरग्निर्हव्यान्यक्रमीत्। दधद्रत्नानि दाशुषे॥
verses.tr: pari vājapatiḥ kaviragnirhavyānyakramīt dadhadratnāni dāśuṣe
verses.en: Round the oblation hath he paced, Agni the wise, the Lord of Strength, Giving the offerer precious boons.

verses.sa: परि त्वाऽग्ने पुरं वयं विप्रं सहस्य धीमहि। धृषद्वर्णं दिवे-दिवे हन्तारं भङ्गुरावताम्॥
verses.tr: pari tvā'gne puraṃ vayaṃ vipraṃ sahasya dhīmahi dhṛṣadvarṇaṃ dive-dive hantāraṃ bhaṅgurāvatām
verses.en: We set thee round us as a fort, victorious Agni, thee a Sage, Of hero lineage, day by day destroyer of our treacherous foes.

verses.sa: त्वमग्ने द्युभिस्त्वमाशुशुक्षणिस्त्वमद्भ्यस्त्वमश्मनस्परि। त्वं वनेभ्यस्त्वमोषधीभ्यस्त्वं नृणां नृपते जायसे शुचिः॥
verses.tr: tvamagne dyubhistvamāśuśukṣaṇistvamadbhyastvamaśmanaspari tvaṃ vanebhyastvamoṣadhībhyastvaṃ nṛṇāṃ nṛpate jāyase śuciḥ
verses.en: Thou, Agni, with the days, fain to shine hitherward, art brought to life from out the waters, from the stone. From out the forest trees and herbs that grow on ground, thou, Sovran Lord of men, art generated pure.

verses.sa: देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवेऽश्विनोर्बाहुभ्यां पूष्णो हस्ताभ्याम्। पृथिव्याः सधस्थादग्निं पुरीष्यमङ्गिरस्वत्खनामि। ज्योतिष्मन्तं त्वाऽग्ने सुप्रतीकमजस्रेण भानुना दीद्यतम्। शिवं प्रजाभ्योऽहिंसन्तं पृथिव्याः सधस्थादग्निं पुरीष्यमङ्गिरस्वत्खनामः॥
verses.tr: devasya tvā savituḥ prasave'śvinorbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyām pṛthivyāḥ sadhasthādagniṃ purīṣyamaṅgirasvatkhanāmi jyotiṣmantaṃ tvā'gne supratīkamajasreṇa bhānunā dīdyatam śivaṃ prajābhyo'hiṃsantaṃ pṛthivyāḥ sadhasthādagniṃ purīṣyamaṅgirasvatkhanāmaḥ
verses.en: At Savitar's, the Shining One's, impulsion, with arms of Asvins and with hands of Pushan, As Angiras was wont to do, I dig thee forth from the seat of Earth, Agni Purishya. Thee, Agni, luminous and fair of aspect, resplendent with imperishable lustre, gracious to living creatures, never harming,"" As Angiras was wont to do, we dig thee forth from the seat of Earth, Agni Purishya.

verses.sa: अपां पृष्ठमसि योनिरग्नेः समुद्रमभितः पिन्वमानम्। वर्धमानो महाँ२ आ च पुष्करे दिवो मात्रया वरिम्णा प्रथस्व॥
verses.tr: apāṃ pṛṣṭhamasi yoniragneḥ samudramabhitaḥ pinvamānam vardhamāno mahāṃ2 ā ca puṣkare divo mātrayā varimṇā prathasva
verses.en: Thou art the Waters back, the womb of Agni, around the ocean as it swells and surges. Waxing to greatness, resting on the lotus, spread thou in amplitude with heaven's own measure.

verses.sa: शर्म च स्थो वर्म च स्थोऽछिद्रे बहुले उभे। व्यचस्वती सं वसाथां भृतमग्निं पुरीष्यम्॥
verses.tr: śarma ca stho varma ca stho'chidre bahule ubhe vyacasvatī saṃ vasāthāṃ bhṛtamagniṃ purīṣyam
verses.en: Ye are a shelter and a shield, uninjured both, and widely spread. Do ye, expansive, cover him: bear ye Purishya Agni up.

verses.sa: सं वसाथां स्वर्विदा समीची उरसा त्मना। अग्निमन्तर्भरिष्यन्ती ज्योतिष्मन्तमजस्रमित्॥
verses.tr: saṃ vasāthāṃ svarvidā samīcī urasā tmanā agnimantarbhariṣyantī jyotiṣmantamajasramit
verses.en: Cover him, finders of the light, united both with breast and self, Bearing between you Agni, the refulgent, everlasting One.

verses.sa: पुरीष्योऽसि विश्वभरा अथर्वा त्वा प्रथमो निरमन्थदग्ने। त्वामग्ने पुष्करादध्यथर्वा निरमन्थत। मूर्ध्नो विश्वस्य वाघतः॥
verses.tr: purīṣyo'si viśvabharā atharvā tvā prathamo niramanthadagne tvāmagne puṣkarādadhyatharvā niramanthata mūrdhno viśvasya vāghataḥ
verses.en: Thou art Purishya, thou support of all. Atharvan was the first, Agni, who rubbed thee into life. Agni, Atharvan brought thee forth by rubbing from the lotus, from The head of Visva, of the Priest.

verses.sa: तमु त्वा दध्यङ्ङृषिः पुत्र ईधे अथर्वणः। वृत्रहणं पुरन्दरम्॥
verses.tr: tamu tvā dadhyaṅṅṛṣiḥ putra īdhe atharvaṇaḥ vṛtrahaṇaṃ purandaram
verses.en: Thee too as Vritra-slayer, thee breaker of forts, the Sage Dadhyach, Son of Atharvan, lighted up.

verses.sa: तमु त्वा पाथ्यो वृषा समीधे दस्युहन्तमम्। धनञ्जयं रणे-रणे॥
verses.tr: tamu tvā pāthyo vṛṣā samīdhe dasyuhantamam dhanañjayaṃ raṇe-raṇe
verses.en: Ukthya the Bull, too, kindled thee the Dasyus most destructive foe, Winner of spoil in every fight.

verses.sa: सीद होतः स्व उ लोके चिकित्वान्सादया यज्ञं सुकृतस्य योनौ। देवावीर्देवान्हविषा यजास्यग्ने बृहद्यजमाने वयो धाः॥
verses.tr: sīda hotaḥ sva u loke cikitvānsādayā yajñaṃ sukṛtasya yonau devāvīrdevānhaviṣā yajāsyagne bṛhadyajamāne vayo dhāḥ
verses.en: Sit, Hotar, in the Hotar's place, observant: lay down the sacrifice in the place of worship. Thou, dear to Gods, shalt serve them with oblation. Agni, give long life to the Sacrificer.

verses.sa: नि होता होतृषदने विदानस्त्वेषो दीदिवाँ२ असदत्सुदक्षः। अदब्धव्रतप्रमतिर्वसिष्ठः सहस्रम्भरः शुचिजिह्वो अग्निः॥
verses.tr: ni hotā hotṛṣadane vidānastveṣo dīdivāṃ2 asadatsudakṣaḥ adabdhavratapramatirvasiṣṭhaḥ sahasrambharaḥ śucijihvo agniḥ
verses.en: Accustomed to the Hotar's place, the Hotar hath seated him, bright, splendid, passing mighty, Whose foresight keeps the Law from violation, excellent, pure-tongued, bringing thousands, Agni.

verses.sa: सं सीदस्व महाँ२ असि शोचस्व देववीतमः। वि धूममग्ने अरुषं मियेध्य सृज प्रशस्त दर्शतम्॥
verses.tr: saṃ sīdasva mahāṃ2 asi śocasva devavītamaḥ vi dhūmamagne aruṣaṃ miyedhya sṛja praśasta darśatam
verses.en: Seat thee, for thou art mighty: shine, best entertainer of the Gods. Worthy of sacred food, praised Agni! loose the smoke, ruddy and beautiful to see.

verses.sa: अपो देवीरुप सृज मधुमतीरयक्ष्माय प्रजाभ्यः। तासामास्थानादुज्जिहतामोषधयः सुपिप्पलाः॥
verses.tr: apo devīrupa sṛja madhumatīrayakṣmāya prajābhyaḥ tāsāmāsthānādujjihatāmoṣadhayaḥ supippalāḥ
verses.en: Pour heavenly Waters honey-sweet here for our health, for progeny. Forth from the place whereon they fall let plants with goodly berries spring.

verses.sa: सं ते वायुर्मातरिश्वा दधातूत्तानाया हृदयं यद्विकस्तम्। यो देवानां चरसि प्राणथेन कस्मै देव वषडस्तु तुभ्यम्॥
verses.tr: saṃ te vāyurmātariśvā dadhātūttānāyā hṛdayaṃ yadvikastam yo devānāṃ carasi prāṇathena kasmai deva vaṣaḍastu tubhyam
verses.en: May Vayu Matarisvan heal and comfort thy broken heart as there supine thou liest. Thou unto whom the breath of Gods gives motion, to Ka, yea, unto thee, O God, be Vashat!

verses.sa: सुजातो ज्योतिषा सह शर्म वरूथमाऽसदत्स्वः। वासो अग्ने विश्वरूपं सं व्ययस्व विभावसो॥
verses.tr: sujāto jyotiṣā saha śarma varūthamā'sadatsvaḥ vāso agne viśvarūpaṃ saṃ vyayasva vibhāvaso
verses.en: He, nobly born with lustre, shield and refuge, hath sat down in light. O Agni, Rich in Splendour, robe thyself in many>hued attire.

verses.sa: उदु तिष्ठ स्वध्वरावा नो देव्या धिया। दृशे च भासा बृहता सुशुक्वनिराग्ने याहि सुशस्तिभिः॥
verses.tr: udu tiṣṭha svadhvarāvā no devyā dhiyā dṛśe ca bhāsā bṛhatā suśukvanirāgne yāhi suśastibhiḥ
verses.en: Lord of fair sacrifice, arise! With Godlike thought protec us well. With great light splendid to behold come, Agni, through sweet hymns of praise.

verses.sa: ऊर्ध्व ऊ षु ण ऊतये तिष्ठा देवो न सविता। ऊर्ध्वो वाजस्य सनिता यदञ्जिभिर्वाघद्भिर्विह्वयामहे॥
verses.tr: ūrdhva ū ṣu ṇa ūtaye tiṣṭhā devo na savitā ūrdhvo vājasya sanitā yadañjibhirvāghadbhirvihvayāmahe
verses.en: Rise up erect to give us aid, stand up like Savitar the God; Erect as strength-bestower when we call aloud, with unguents and with priests on thee.

verses.sa: स जातो गर्भो असि रोदस्योरग्ने चारुर्विभृत ओषधीषु। चित्रः शिशुः परि तमांस्यक्तून्प्र मातृभ्यो अधि कनिक्रदद्गाः॥
verses.tr: sa jāto garbho asi rodasyoragne cārurvibhṛta oṣadhīṣu citraḥ śiśuḥ pari tamāṃsyaktūnpra mātṛbhyo adhi kanikradadgāḥ
verses.en: Thou, being born, art Child of Earth and Heaven, parted, fair Babe, among the plants, O Agni. The glooms of night thou, brilliant child, subduest, and art come forth, loud roaring, from the Mothers.

verses.sa: स्थिरो भव वीड्वङ्ग आशुर्भव वाज्यर्वन्। पृथुर्भव सुषदस्त्वमग्नेः पुरीषवाहणः॥
verses.tr: sthiro bhava vīḍvaṅga āśurbhava vājyarvan pṛthurbhava suṣadastvamagneḥ purīṣavāhaṇaḥ
verses.en: Steady be thou, and firm of limb. Steed, be a racer fleet of foot. Broad be thou, pleasant as a seat, bearing the store which Agni needs.

verses.sa: शिवो भव प्रजाभ्यो मानुषीभ्यस्त्वमङ्गिरः। मा द्यावापृथिवी अभि शोचीर्माऽन्तरिक्षं मा वनस्पतीन्॥
verses.tr: śivo bhava prajābhyo mānuṣībhyastvamaṅgiraḥ mā dyāvāpṛthivī abhi śocīrmā'ntarikṣaṃ mā vanaspatīn
verses.en: Be thou propitious, Angiras, to creatures of the human race. Set not on fire the heaven and earth, nor air's mid-region, nor the trees.

verses.sa: प्रैतु वाजी कनिक्रदन्नानदद्रासभः पत्वा। भरन्नग्निं पुरीष्यं मा पाद्यायुषः पुरा। वृषाग्निं वृषणं भरन्नपां गर्भं समुद्रियम्। अग्न आ याहि वीतये॥
verses.tr: praitu vājī kanikradannānadadrāsabhaḥ patvā bharannagniṃ purīṣyaṃ mā pādyāyuṣaḥ purā vṛṣāgniṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ bharannapāṃ garbhaṃ samudriyam agna ā yāhi vītaye
verses.en: Forth with loud neighing go the Steed, the Ass that shouteth as he runs. Bearing Purishya Agni on, let him not perish ere his time, Male bearer of male Agni, Child of Waters, Offspring of the Sea. Agni, come hither to the feast.

verses.sa: ऋतं सत्यमृतं सत्यमग्निं पुरीष्यमङ्गिरस्वद्भरामः। ओषधयः प्रति मोदध्वमग्निमेतं शिवमायन्तमभ्यत्र युष्माः। व्यस्यन् विश्वा अनिरा अमीवा निषीदन्नो अप दुर्मतिं जहि॥
verses.tr: ṛtaṃ satyamṛtaṃ satyamagniṃ purīṣyamaṅgirasvadbharāmaḥ oṣadhayaḥ prati modadhvamagnimetaṃ śivamāyantamabhyatra yuṣmāḥ vyasyan viśvā anirā amīvā niṣīdanno apa durmatiṃ jahi
verses.en: The Law the Tutha, the Law the Truth, As Angiras was wont to do, we bear Purishya Agni on. Ye Plants, with joyous welcome greet this Agni, auspicious One who cometh on to meet you. Removing all distresses and afflictions, here settle down and banish evil purpose.

verses.sa: ओषधयः प्रति गृभ्णीत पुष्पवतीः सुपिप्पलाः। अयं वो गर्भ ऋत्वियः प्रत्नं सधस्थमाऽसदत्॥
verses.tr: oṣadhayaḥ prati gṛbhṇīta puṣpavatīḥ supippalāḥ ayaṃ vo garbha ṛtviyaḥ pratnaṃ sadhasthamā'sadat
verses.en: Welcome him joyfully, ye Plants, laden with bloom and goodly fruit. This seasonable Child of yours hath settled in his ancient seat.

verses.sa: वि पाजसा पृथुना शोशुचानो बाधस्व द्विषो रक्षसो अमीवाः। सुशर्मणो बृहतः शर्मणि स्यामग्नेरहं सुहवस्य प्रणीतौ॥
verses.tr: vi pājasā pṛthunā śośucāno bādhasva dviṣo rakṣaso amīvāḥ suśarmaṇo bṛhataḥ śarmaṇi syāmagnerahaṃ suhavasya praṇītau
verses.en: Resplendent with thy wide-extending lustre dispel the terrors of the fiends who hate us. May lofty Agni be my guide and shelter, ready to hear our call, the good Protector.

verses.sa: आपो हि ष्ठा मयोभुवस्ता न ऊर्जे दधातन। महे रणाय चक्षसे॥
verses.tr: āpo hi ṣṭhā mayobhuvastā na ūrje dadhātana mahe raṇāya cakṣase
verses.en: Ye, Waters, are beneficent, so help ye us to energy L\ That we may look on great delight.

verses.sa: यो वः शिवतमो रसस्तस्य भाजयतेह नः। उशतीरिव मातरः॥
verses.tr: yo vaḥ śivatamo rasastasya bhājayateha naḥ uśatīriva mātaraḥ
verses.en: Give us a portion of the sap, the most propitious that ye have. Like mothers in their longing love,

verses.sa: तस्मा अरं गमाम वो यस्य क्षयाय जिन्वथ। आपो जनयथा च नः॥
verses.tr: tasmā araṃ gamāma vo yasya kṣayāya jinvatha āpo janayathā ca naḥ
verses.en: To you we gladly come for him to whose abode ye lead us on: And, Waters, give us procreant strength.

verses.sa: मित्रः संसृज्य पृथिवीं भूमिं च ज्योतिषा सह। सुजातं जातवेदसमयक्ष्माय त्वा सं सृजामि प्रजाभ्यः॥
verses.tr: mitraḥ saṃsṛjya pṛthivīṃ bhūmiṃ ca jyotiṣā saha sujātaṃ jātavedasamayakṣmāya tvā saṃ sṛjāmi prajābhyaḥ
verses.en: Mitra, having commingled earth and ground together with the light—For health to creatures mix I thee Omniscient and nobly born.

verses.sa: रुद्राः संसृज्य पृथिवीं बृहज्ज्योतिः समीधिरे। तेषां भानुरजस्र इच्छुक्रो देवेषु रोचते॥
verses.tr: rudrāḥ saṃsṛjya pṛthivīṃ bṛhajjyotiḥ samīdhire teṣāṃ bhānurajasra icchukro deveṣu rocate
verses.en: The Rudras, having mixed the earth, set all aglow the lofty light. Bright and perpetual their light verily shines among the Gods.

verses.sa: संसृष्टा वसुभी रुद्रैर्धीरैः कर्मण्या मृदम्। हस्ताभ्यां मृद्वीं कृत्वा सिनीवाली कृणोतु ताम्॥
verses.tr: saṃsṛṣṭā vasubhī rudrairdhīraiḥ karmaṇyā mṛdam hastābhyāṃ mṛdvīṃ kṛtvā sinīvālī kṛṇotu tām
verses.en: The lump of clay that hath been mixed by Vasus, Rudras,. by the wise, May Sinivali with her hands soften and fit it for the work.

verses.sa: सिनीवाली सुकपर्दा सुकुरीरा स्वौपशा। सा तुभ्यमदिते मह्योखां दधातु हस्तयोः॥
verses.tr: sinīvālī sukapardā sukurīrā svaupaśā sā tubhyamadite mahyokhāṃ dadhātu hastayoḥ
verses.en: May Sinivali with fair braids, with beauteous crest, with lovely locks, May she, O mighty Aditi, bestow the Fire pan in thy hands'

verses.sa: उखां कृणोतु शक्त्या बाहुभ्यामदितिर्धिया। माता पुत्रं यथोपस्थे साऽग्निं बिभर्तु गर्भ आ। मखस्य शिरोऽसि॥
verses.tr: ukhāṃ kṛṇotu śaktyā bāhubhyāmaditirdhiyā mātā putraṃ yathopasthe sā'gniṃ bibhartu garbha ā makhasya śiro'si
verses.en: Aditi shape the Fire-pan with her power, her arms, her intellect, And in her womb bear Agni as a mother, in her lap, her son.

verses.sa: वसवस्त्वा कृण्वन्तु गायत्रेण छन्दसाऽङ्गिरस्वद्ध्रुवाऽसि पृथिव्यसि धारया मयि प्रजां रायस्पोषं गौपत्यं सुवीर्यं सजातान्यजमानाय रुद्रास्त्वा कृण्वन्तु त्रैष्टुभेन छन्दसाऽङ्गिरस्वद्ध्रुवाऽस्यन्तरिक्षमसि धारया मयि प्रजां रायस्पोषं गौपत्यं सुवीर्यं सजातान्यजमानायादित्यास्त्वा कृण्वन्तु जागतेन छन्दसाऽङ्गिरस्वद्ध्रुवासि द्यौरसि धारया मयि प्रजां रायस्पोषं गौपत्यं सुवीर्यं सजातान्यजमानाय विश्वे त्वा देवा वैश्वानराः कृण्वन्त्वानुष्टुभेन छन्दसाऽङ्गिरस्वद्ध्रुवाऽसि दिशोऽसि धारया मयि प्रजां रायस्पोषं गौपत्यं सुवीर्यं सजातान्यजमानाय॥
verses.tr: vasavastvā kṛṇvantu gāyatreṇa chandasā'ṅgirasvaddhruvā'si pṛthivyasi dhārayā mayi prajāṃ rāyaspoṣaṃ gaupatyaṃ suvīryaṃ sajātānyajamānāya rudrāstvā kṛṇvantu traiṣṭubhena chandasā'ṅgirasvaddhruvā'syantarikṣamasi dhārayā mayi prajāṃ rāyaspoṣaṃ gaupatyaṃ suvīryaṃ sajātānyajamānāyādityāstvā kṛṇvantu jāgatena chandasā'ṅgirasvaddhruvāsi dyaurasi dhārayā mayi prajāṃ rāyaspoṣaṃ gaupatyaṃ suvīryaṃ sajātānyajamānāya viśve tvā devā vaiśvānarāḥ kṛṇvantvānuṣṭubhena chandasā'ṅgirasvaddhruvā'si diśo'si dhārayā mayi prajāṃ rāyaspoṣaṃ gaupatyaṃ suvīryaṃ sajātānyajamānāya
verses.en: With Gayatri, like Angiras the Vasus form and fashion thee! Stedfast art thou, thou art the Earth. Establish in me progeny, command of cattle, growth of wealth, kinsmen for me the worshipper. With Trishtup may the Rudras, like Angiras, form and fashion thee. Stedfast art thou, thou art the Air. Establish in me, etc., as above. With Jagati, like Angiras, Adityas form and fashion thee! Stedfast art thou, thou art the Sky. Establish in me, etc. Friends of all men, the All-Gods with Anushtup form thee Angiras like. Stedfast art thou, thou art the Quarters. Establish in me,. etc.

verses.sa: अदित्यै रास्नास्यदितिष्टे बिलं गृभ्णातु। कृत्वाय सा महीमुखां मृन्मयीं योनिमग्नये। पुत्रेभ्यः प्रायच्छददितिः श्रपयानिति॥
verses.tr: adityai rāsnāsyaditiṣṭe bilaṃ gṛbhṇātu kṛtvāya sā mahīmukhāṃ mṛnmayīṃ yonimagnaye putrebhyaḥ prāyacchadaditiḥ śrapayāniti
verses.en: The zone of Aditi art thou. Aditi seize thy hollow space. She, having made the great Fire-pan, a womb for Agni, formed of clay, Aditi, gave it to her Sons and, Let them bake it, were her words.

verses.sa: वसवस्त्वा धूपयन्तु गायत्रेण छन्दसाऽङ्गिरस्वद्रुद्रास्त्वा धूपयन्तु त्रैष्टुभेन छन्दसाऽङ्गिरस्वदादित्यास्त्वा धूपयन्तु जागतेन छन्दसाऽङ्गिरस्वद्विश्वे त्वा देवा वैश्वानरा धूपयन्त्वानुष्टुभेन छन्दसाऽङ्गिरस्वदिन्द्रस्त्वा धूपयतु वरुणस्त्वा धूपयतु विष्णुस्त्वा धूपयतु॥
verses.tr: vasavastvā dhūpayantu gāyatreṇa chandasā'ṅgirasvadrudrāstvā dhūpayantu traiṣṭubhena chandasā'ṅgirasvadādityāstvā dhūpayantu jāgatena chandasā'ṅgirasvadviśve tvā devā vaiśvānarā dhūpayantvānuṣṭubhena chandasā'ṅgirasvadindrastvā dhūpayatu varuṇastvā dhūpayatu viṣṇustvā dhūpayatu
verses.en: The Vasus make thee fragrant, as Angiras did, with Gayatri! The Rudras make thee fragrant with the Trishtup, as did Angiras! With Gayatri, like Angiras, may the Adityas perfume thee. Dear to all men, may the All-Gods with the Anushtup sweeten thee, as Angiras was wont to do. May Indra make thee odorous. May Varuna make thee odorous. May Vishnu make thee odorous.

verses.sa: अदितिष्ट्वा देवी विश्वदेव्यावती पृथिव्याः सधस्थे अङ्गिरस्वत् खनत्ववट देवानां त्वा पत्नीर्देवीर्विश्वदेव्यावतीः पृथिव्याः सधस्थे अङ्गिरस्वद्दधतूखे धिषणास्त्वा देवीर्विश्वदेव्यावतीः पृथिव्याः सधस्थे अङ्गिरस्वदभीन्धतामुखे वरूत्रीष्ट्वा देवीर्विश्वदेव्यावतीः पृथिव्याः सधस्थे अङ्गिरस्वच्छ्रपयन्तूखे ग्नास्त्वा देवीर्विश्वदेव्यावतीः पृथिव्याः सधस्थे अङ्गिरस्वत्पचन्तूखे जनयस्त्वाच्छिन्नपत्रा देवीर्विश्वदेव्यावतीः पृथिव्याः सधस्थे अङ्गिरस्वत्पचन्तूखे॥
verses.tr: aditiṣṭvā devī viśvadevyāvatī pṛthivyāḥ sadhasthe aṅgirasvat khanatvavaṭa devānāṃ tvā patnīrdevīrviśvadevyāvatīḥ pṛthivyāḥ sadhasthe aṅgirasvaddadhatūkhe dhiṣaṇāstvā devīrviśvadevyāvatīḥ pṛthivyāḥ sadhasthe aṅgirasvadabhīndhatāmukhe varūtrīṣṭvā devīrviśvadevyāvatīḥ pṛthivyāḥ sadhasthe aṅgirasvacchrapayantūkhe gnāstvā devīrviśvadevyāvatīḥ pṛthivyāḥ sadhasthe aṅgirasvatpacantūkhe janayastvācchinnapatrā devīrviśvadevyāvatīḥ pṛthivyāḥ sadhasthe aṅgirasvatpacantūkhe
verses.en: Pit! I' Angiras-like may Aditi the Goddess, beloved by all Gods, dig thee in Earth's bosom. Pan! Angirases may the Gods' heavenly Consorts, dear to all Gods, in the Earth's bosom place thee. Pan! Angirases may Dhishanas, Divine Ones, dear to all Gods, in the Earth's bosom light thee. Pan! Angiras-like may the divine Varunas, dear to all Gods, in the earth's bosom heat thee. Pan! Angiras-like may the celestial Ladies, dear to all Gods, in the earth's bosom bake thee. Angiras-like may the celestial Matrons, beloved by all the Gods, with undipped pinions, within the lap of Earth, O Firepan, bake thee.

verses.sa: मित्रस्य चर्षणीधृतोऽवो देवस्य सानसि। द्युम्नं चित्रश्रवस्तमम्॥
verses.tr: mitrasya carṣaṇīdhṛto'vo devasya sānasi dyumnaṃ citraśravastamam
verses.en: The gainful grace of Mitra, God, supporter of the race of man, Is glorious, of most wondrous fame.

verses.sa: देवस्त्वा सवितोद्वपतु सुपाणिः स्वङ्गुरिः सुबाहुरुत शक्त्या। अव्यथमाना पृथिव्यामाशा दिश आ पृण॥
verses.tr: devastvā savitodvapatu supāṇiḥ svaṅguriḥ subāhuruta śaktyā avyathamānā pṛthivyāmāśā diśa ā pṛṇa
verses.en: With lovely arms, with lovely hands, with lovely fingers may the God Savitar make thee clean, yea, by the power he hath. Not trembling on the earth fill thou the regions, fill the Quarters full.

verses.sa: उत्थाय बृहती भवोदु तिष्ठ ध्रुवा त्वम्। मित्रैतां त उखां परि ददाम्यभित्त्या एषा मा भेदि॥
verses.tr: utthāya bṛhatī bhavodu tiṣṭha dhruvā tvam mitraitāṃ ta ukhāṃ pari dadāmyabhittyā eṣā mā bhedi
verses.en: Having arisen wax thou great, yea, stand thou up immovable. To thee, O Mitra, I entrust this Fire-pan for security. May it remain without a break.

verses.sa: वसवस्त्वाऽऽछृन्दन्तु गायत्रेण छन्दसाऽङ्गिरस्वद्रुद्रास्त्वाऽऽछृन्दन्तु त्रैष्टुभेन छन्दसाऽङ्गिरस्वदादित्यास्त्वाऽऽछृन्दन्तु जागतेन छन्दसाऽङ्गिरस्वद्विश्वे त्वा देवा वैश्वानरा आछृन्दन्त्वानुष्टुभेन छन्दसाऽङ्गिरस्वत्॥
verses.tr: vasavastvā''chṛndantu gāyatreṇa chandasā'ṅgirasvadrudrāstvā''chṛndantu traiṣṭubhena chandasā'ṅgirasvadādityāstvā''chṛndantu jāgatena chandasā'ṅgirasvadviśve tvā devā vaiśvānarā āchṛndantvānuṣṭubhena chandasā'ṅgirasvat
verses.en: Thee may the Vasus, Angiras-like, fill with the metre Gayatri. Thee may the Rudras, Angiras-like, fill with the Trishtup metre full, Thee may Aditya, Angiras-like, fill with the metre Jagati. With the Anushtup metre may the All-Gods, dear to all men, fill thee, full, as Angiras was wont.

verses.sa: आकूतिमग्निं प्रयुजं स्वाहा मनो मेधामग्निं प्रयुजं स्वाहा चित्तं विज्ञातमग्निं प्रयुजं स्वाहा वाचो विधृतिमग्निं प्रयुजं स्वाहा प्रजापतये मनवे स्वाहा ऽग्नये वैश्वानराय स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: ākūtimagniṃ prayujaṃ svāhā mano medhāmagniṃ prayujaṃ svāhā cittaṃ vijñātamagniṃ prayujaṃ svāhā vāco vidhṛtimagniṃ prayujaṃ svāhā prajāpataye manave svāhā 'gnaye vaiśvānarāya svāhā
verses.en: Intention, Agni, Motive, Hail! Mind, Wisdom, Agni, Motive, Hail! Thought, Knowledge, Agni, Motive, Hail! Rule of Speech, Agni, Motive, Hail! To Manu Lord of creatures, Hail! To Agni dear to all men, Hail!,

verses.sa: विश्वो देवस्य नेतुर्मर्तो वुरीत सख्यम्। विश्वो राय इषुध्यति द्युम्नं वृणीत पुष्यसे स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: viśvo devasya neturmarto vurīta sakhyam viśvo rāya iṣudhyati dyumnaṃ vṛṇīta puṣyase svāhā
verses.en: May every mortal man elect the friendship of the guiding God. Each one solicits him for wealth: let him seek fame to prosper him. All-hail!

verses.sa: मा सु भित्था मा सु रिषोऽम्ब धृष्णु वीरयस्व सु। अग्निश्चेदं करिष्यथः॥
verses.tr: mā su bhitthā mā su riṣo'mba dhṛṣṇu vīrayasva su agniścedaṃ kariṣyathaḥ
verses.en: Break not, nor suffer any harm. Endure, O Mother, and be brave; This work will thou and Agni do.

verses.sa: दृंहस्व देवि पृथिवि स्वस्तय आसुरी माया स्वधया कृतासि। जुष्टं देवेभ्य इदमस्तु हव्यमरिष्टा त्वमुदिहि यज्ञे अस्मिन्॥
verses.tr: dṛṃhasva devi pṛthivi svastaya āsurī māyā svadhayā kṛtāsi juṣṭaṃ devebhya idamastu havyamariṣṭā tvamudihi yajñe asmin
verses.en: Be firm for weal, O Goddess Earth. Made in the wonted manner thou Art a celestial design. Acceptable to Gods% be this oblation. Arise thou in this sacrifice uninjured.

verses.sa: द्र्वन्नः सर्पिरासुतिः प्रत्नो होता वरेण्यः। सहसस्पुत्रो अद्भुतः॥
verses.tr: drvannaḥ sarpirāsutiḥ pratno hotā vareṇyaḥ sahasasputro adbhutaḥ
verses.en: Wood-fed, bedewed with sacred oil, ancient, Invoker, excellent. The Son of Strength, the Wonderful.

verses.sa: परस्या अधि संवतोऽवराँ२ अभ्या तर। यत्राहमस्मि ताँ२ अव॥
verses.tr: parasyā adhi saṃvato'varāṃ2 abhyā tara yatrāhamasmi tāṃ2 ava
verses.en: Abandoning the foeman's host, pass hither to this company: Assist the men with whom I stand.

verses.sa: परमस्याः परावतो रोहिदश्व इहा गहि। पुरीष्यः पुरुप्रियोऽग्ने त्वं तरा मृधः॥
verses.tr: paramasyāḥ parāvato rohidaśva ihā gahi purīṣyaḥ purupriyo'gne tvaṃ tarā mṛdhaḥ
verses.en: From the remotest distance come. Lord of the Red Steeds, hitherward. Do thou Purishya, Agni, loved of many, overcome our foes.

verses.sa: यदग्ने कानि कानि चिदा ते दारूणि दध्मसि। सर्वं तदस्तु ते घृतं तज्जुषस्व यविष्ठ्य॥
verses.tr: yadagne kāni kāni cidā te dārūṇi dadhmasi sarvaṃ tadastu te ghṛtaṃ tajjuṣasva yaviṣṭhya
verses.en: O Agni, whatsoever be the fuel that we lay on thee. May that be butter to thee. Be pleased therewith. Most Youthful God.

verses.sa: यदत्त्युपजिह्विका यद्वम्रो अतिसर्पति। सर्वं तदस्तु ते घृतं तज्जुषस्व यविष्ठ्य॥
verses.tr: yadattyupajihvikā yadvamro atisarpati sarvaṃ tadastu te ghṛtaṃ tajjuṣasva yaviṣṭhya
verses.en: That which the termite eats, away, that over which the emmet crawls—Butter be all of this to thee. Be pleased therewith, Most Youthful God.

verses.sa: अहरहरप्रयावं भरन्तोऽश्वायेव तिष्ठते घासमस्मै। रायस्पोषेण समिषा मदन्तोऽग्ने मा ते प्रतिवेशा रिषाम॥
verses.tr: aharaharaprayāvaṃ bharanto'śvāyeva tiṣṭhate ghāsamasmai rāyaspoṣeṇa samiṣā madanto'gne mā te prativeśā riṣāma
verses.en: Bringing to him, with care unceasing, fodder day after day as to a stabled courser, Joying in food and in the growth of riches, may we thy neighbours, Agni, ne'er be injured.

verses.sa: नाभा पृथिव्याः समिधाने अग्नौ रायस्पोषाय बृहते हवामहे। इरम्मदं बृहदुक्थ्यं यजत्रं जेतारमग्निं पृतनासु सासहिम्॥
verses.tr: nābhā pṛthivyāḥ samidhāne agnau rāyaspoṣāya bṛhate havāmahe irammadaṃ bṛhadukthyaṃ yajatraṃ jetāramagniṃ pṛtanāsu sāsahim
verses.en: While on earth's navel Agni is enkindled, we call, for ample increase of our riches, On Agni joying in the draught, much-lauded, worshipful, victor conquering in battle.

verses.sa: याः सेना अभीत्वरीराव्याधिनीरुगणा उत। ये स्तेना ये च तस्करास्ताँस्ते अग्नेऽपि दधाम्यास्ये॥
verses.tr: yāḥ senā abhītvarīrāvyādhinīrugaṇā uta ye stenā ye ca taskarāstāṃste agne'pi dadhāmyāsye
verses.en: Whatever hosts there are, fiercely assailant, charging in hk lengthened lines, drawn up in order. Whatever thieves there are, whatever robbers, all these I cast into thy mouth, O Agni.

verses.sa: दंष्ट्राभ्यां मलिम्लूञ्जम्भ्यैस्तस्कराँ२ उत। हनुभ्यां स्तेनान् भगवस्ताँस्त्वं खाद सुखादितान्॥
verses.tr: daṃṣṭrābhyāṃ malimlūñjambhyaistaskarāṃ2 uta hanubhyāṃ stenān bhagavastāṃstvaṃ khāda sukhāditān
verses.en: Devour the burglars with both tusks, destroy the robbers with thy teeth. With both thy jaws, thou Holy One, eat up those thieves well champed and chewed.

verses.sa: ये जनेषु मलिम्लव स्तेनासस्तस्करा वने। ये कक्षेष्वघायवस्ताँस्ते दधामि जम्भयोः॥
verses.tr: ye janeṣu malimlava stenāsastaskarā vane ye kakṣeṣvaghāyavastāṃste dadhāmi jambhayoḥ
verses.en: The burglars living among men, the thieves and robbers in the wood,' Criminals lurking in their lairs, these do I lay between thy jaws.

verses.sa: यो अस्मभ्यमरातीयाद्यश्च नो द्वेषते जनः। निन्दाद्यो अस्मान्धिप्साच्च सर्वं तं भस्मसा कुरु॥
verses.tr: yo asmabhyamarātīyādyaśca no dveṣate janaḥ nindādyo asmāndhipsācca sarvaṃ taṃ bhasmasā kuru
verses.en: Him who would seek to injure us, the man who looks on us with hate, Turn thou to ashes, and the man who slanders and would injure us.

verses.sa: संशितं मे ब्रह्म संशितं वीर्यं बलम्। संशितं क्षत्रं जिष्णु यस्याहमस्मि पुरोहितः॥
verses.tr: saṃśitaṃ me brahma saṃśitaṃ vīryaṃ balam saṃśitaṃ kṣatraṃ jiṣṇu yasyāhamasmi purohitaḥ
verses.en: Quickened is this my priestly rank, quickened is manly strength and force, Quickened is his victorious power of whom I am the Household priest.

verses.sa: उदेषां बाहू अतिरमुद्वर्चो अथो बलम्। क्षिणोमि ब्रह्मणाऽमित्रानुन्नयामि स्वाँ२ अहम्॥
verses.tr: udeṣāṃ bāhū atiramudvarco atho balam kṣiṇomi brahmaṇā'mitrānunnayāmi svāṃ2 aham
verses.en: The arms of these men have I raised, have raised their lustre and their strength, With priestly power I ruin foes and lift my friends to high estate.

verses.sa: अन्नपतेऽन्नस्य नो देह्यनमीवस्य शुष्मिणः। प्र-प्र दातारं तारिष ऊर्जं नो धेहि द्विपदे चतुष्पदे॥
verses.tr: annapate'nnasya no dehyanamīvasya śuṣmiṇaḥ pra-pra dātāraṃ tāriṣa ūrjaṃ no dhehi dvipade catuṣpade
verses.en: A share of food, O Lord of Food, vouchsafe us, invigorating food that brings no sickness. Onward, still onward lead the giver. Grant us maintenance both for quadruped and biped.
